ShareCursor startup-fix installers

Source commit: 090bc4fefb12674957d24103df58a3ac65c3ea71
Pull request: https://github.com/alimomin-12/ShareCursor/pull/1
Build: https://github.com/alimomin-12/ShareCursor/actions/runs/37185207278

Windows: ShareCursor-Setup-0.6.0.exe
macOS (Apple Silicon + Intel): ShareCursor-0.6.0.dmg
Checksums: ShareCursor-SHA256SUMS.txt

These are development builds containing the startup fix, with the existing 0.6.0 package version. They have not been published as a new release.

Automated formatting, clippy, and native tests passed on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Full tray/GUI tests passed on native Windows and macOS runners (30 tests each). Both installer formats and downloaded file checksums were verified. Manual installation and UI interaction have not been tested on physical machines.

On first launch, Settings opens and the per-user config is created automatically. Save the same pairing code on both computers and close Settings to begin pairing.
